name: BeAI.online
author: BeAi.online

sections.description:
BeAI allows you to generate graphics using artificial intelligence (AI). You can generate graphics using a prompt or based on the page content. Images can be saved to the WordPress library and set as a thumbnail.

External Service Information

The plugin uses the following third-party service:

  • Service Name: BEAI
  • Service URL: https://admin.beai.online
  • Service Terms of Use: https://admin.beai.online/terms
  • Service Privacy Policy: https://admin.beai.online/privacy

By using this plugin, you agree to the terms and conditions and privacy policy of the BEAI service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ folder.
  2. Go to the Plugins page and activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
How do I use this plugin?

In the BeAI tab, you can configure the plugin and top up tokens with which you can generate images. Images can be generated from each post in the sidebar.

How to uninstall the plugin?

Simply deactivate and delete the plugin.

What third-party service does this plugin use?

This plugin relies on the BEAI service to generate images. The plugin sends prompts and page texts in requests to https://admin.beai.online/api/generate to generate and retrieve images.

Why does the plugin need to use this service?

The BEAI service provides advanced image generation capabilities that are essential for the functionality of this plugin. By leveraging BEAI, we can ensure high-quality images generation for your WordPress site.

What data is sent to the third-party service?

The plugin sends specific data inputs required for content generation, like prompts and page content. No personal or sensitive data is sent to the third-party service.
